extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for patent examiners on preparing restriction requirements: ensure the restriction requirement is complete and, when the claimed inventions involve technologies outside the examiner's art, refer the application to an examiner who regularly examines that technology for assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make requirement complete
rubrics_metrics.description: When making a restriction requirement, every effort should be made to have the requirement be complete.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The MPEP directs examiners to strive for completeness when issuing restriction requirements (i.e., do not omit necessary elements or leave the requirement ambiguous).

rubrics_metrics.name: Refer when claimed inventions fall in other technology areas
rubrics_metrics.description: If some of the claimed inventions are classifiable in a technology that the examiner does not examine and the examiner has any doubt as to the proper restriction among the claimed inventions, the application should be referred to an examiner who regularly examines that technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where an examiner lacks subject-matter jurisdiction or expertise for portions of the claimed inventions and is uncertain about proper restriction, the application must be referred to an examiner in the appropriate technology area for determination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obtain assistance from the referred examiner
rubrics_metrics.description: Such examiner should render the necessary assistance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The examiner to whom the application is referred is expected to provide the needed analysis or input to enable a complete and proper restriction requirement; the originating examiner should rely on that assistance to resolve doubts about restriction.
